hypothesis: Ballot stuffing: a voter can submit Enc(1000) instead of Enc(1) and the tally accepts it
statement: The tally accepted a ballot encrypting 1000 (A=4  B=3  C=2 became A=1004  B=3  C=2). A balanced ballot of [3, -2, 0] changed the result (A=7  B=1  C=2) while the totals still added up to the turnout.

checks.name: before the attack the tally is the honest one
the database accepts a ballot that encrypts 1000
the tally counts it as 1000 votes
the only symptom is in the aggregate: totals no longer add up to the turnout
checks.detail: 1009 votes from 10 voters; nothing tells which ballot or which option

checks.name: the database accepts a ballot that encrypts 3, -2 and 0
the tally moves two votes from B to A and adds one
this time nothing is flagged: the totals add up to the turnout
checks.detail: 10 votes from 10 voters; page says "Decrypted in 94 ms. 10 votes from 10 voters."
